item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0024-R01-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0024-R01-E002","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0024-R01-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0024-R01-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0024-R01-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0024-R01-E006","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Egypt reported that local administrative units have legal personality and independent budgets, that local councils are directly elected for four-year terms, and that the constitutional framework provides representation provisions for youth, women, workers and farmers, Christians, and persons with disabilities; councils may oversee executive authorities and cannot be dissolved through a general administrative procedure.","notes":["Narrowed “seats are reserved” to “representation provisions,” because the excerpt specifies quotas or appropriate representation rather than uniformly reserving seats."]}]}
